newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Seamico says buy Thai bank stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Seamico says buy Thai bank stocks.

text.p: Seamico Securities Plc said on Tuesday investors should begin accumulating blue-chip Thai bank stocks which have been heavily sold since the beginning of October.
"The recent intensified concerns over the property sector's cash flow difficulties combined with economic problems has driven bank prices down to near buy levels," Seamico said in a report.

Heavy selling of leading banks by foreign funds has seen the sector lose more than 20 percent of its value this month. Bank shares are heavily weighted on the Stock Exchange of Thailand index, which is now at 39-month lows.
Brokers said the selling was mainly due to worse than originally anticipated financial results by banks this year.
Seamico said it recommends Thai Farmers Bank Plc, Bangkok Bank Plc and Siam Commercial Bank.
The brokerage said Thai Farmers Bank has the most attractive price-to-book valuation in the sector.

Bangkok Bank Plc is rated a buy on the basis of strong provisioning and Siam Commericial Bank is seen to be good value in the medium term although it has heightened loan exposure to large corporates, Seamico said.
